foundingOffer.label: Founding offer
foundingOffer.note: Founding prices begin when Pravely launches. The regular price is shown beside each plan so you can see what you save.
foundingOffer.headline: Be one of the first 75 people building a calmer, more intentional financial life with Pravely.
foundingOffer.window: The founding offer runs for 60 days from launch, or until all 75 founding places are taken — whichever comes first.
includes: The founding price, kept for good — Plus for $69 instead of $89, Complete for $139 instead of $169.
A founding edition of the Pravely workbook.
A founders badge on your Pravely profile.
A numbered founders certificate — Founder #12 of 75, issued in the order people buy.
Founders can vote on the roadmap and receive early testing invitations. Votes inform prioritization but do not guarantee that a feature will be built.
Priority support — your messages go to the front of the queue, and founders are answered before other support requests.
